warnings.headline: Red warning for Epirus
warnings.description: Locally heavy rain. Precipitation amount forecasted above 80 mm  in 12 hours. TAKE ACTION to protect yourself and act on advice given by authorities. Widespread flooding with significant risk to life and evacuations are possible. Severe travel disruption and loss of power, communications and water supplies is likely. Dangerous driving conditions due to reduced visibility and aquaplaning.

warnings.headline: Orange warning for Central Makedonia
warnings.description: Locally heavy rain, mainly in the Prefecture of Pieria and the Prefecture of Chalkidiki. Precipitation amount forecasted from  30  to 60 mm  in 12 hours. BE PREPARED to protect yourself and your property. Some flooding of properties and transport networks are possible. Disruption to power, communications and water supplies are possible. Some evacuations may be required. Dangerous driving conditions due to reduced visibility and aquaplaning

warnings.headline: Red warning for West Sterea
warnings.description: Severe thunderstorms accompanied  by heavy rainfall and strong winds are expected. TAKE ACTION to protect yourself and act on advice given by authorities. Widespread, violent thunderstorms are likely with danger to life from lightning, hail, flooding and storm damage. Transport and power disruption can be expected. Significant disruption to normal routines is possible. Avoid making non-essential journeys.

warnings.headline: Orange warning for Central Makedonia
warnings.description: Severe thunderstorms in place probably accompanied by strong winds  and hail at times. Mainly in the Prefecture of Pieria and the Prefecture of Chalkidiki BE PREPARED for severe thunderstorms causing significant impact and protect yourself from lightning. Damage to property and trees may occur. Flash flooding, wind gusts and hail are possible. Transport and outdoor activities disruption can be expected.

warnings.headline: Yellow warning for Thraki
warnings.description: Locally intensive rain. Precipitation amount forecasted from  10  to 30 mm  in 12 hours. BE AWARE of the potential for localised flooding of a small number of properties, with local disruption to outdoor activities. Difficult driving conditions due to reduced visibility and aquaplaning.

warnings.headline: Yellow warning for Thraki
warnings.description: Locally thunderstorms. BE AWARE that thunderstorms may occur.  Take extra care in exposed areas, like mountains, forest and open terrain. Disruption to outdoor activities is possible.

warnings.headline: Orange Wind for Thessalia
warnings.description: Strong gale force (9 B) winds are expected to prevail. BE PREPARED for disruption, structural damage and risk of injury from uprooted trees and flying debris. Disruption to power supplies are possible.

warnings.headline: Vântul se va intensifica, cu rafale de 50...70 km/h. Va ninge slab, dar viscolit, iar vizibilitatea va scădea sub 100 m.
warnings.description: Winds will strengthen with gusts between 50 and 70 km/h. There will be light blowing snow, and visibility will drop below 100 m.

warnings.headline: Vântul va continua să prezinte intensificări, cu rafale de 50...70 km/h. În județele Teleorman, Giurgiu, Călărași, Ilfov, municipiul București și local în județele Ialomița și Constanța intensificările de vânt vor fi asociate temporar cu ninsoare (cantități de 5...15 l/mp și izolat în sudul Munteniei 20 l/mp), va fi viscol, iar vizibilitatea va scădea local sub 100 m.
warnings.description: The wind will continue to strengthen, with gusts of 50 to 70 km/h. In the counties of Teleorman, Giurgiu, Călărași, Ilfov, Bucharest Municipality, and locally in the counties of Ialomița and Constanța, the wind gusts will be temporarily accompanied by snowfall (accumulations of 5 to 15 l/sqm, and isolated 20 l/sqm in southern Muntenia), blizzard conditions will occur, and visibility will locally drop below 100 m."

warnings.headline: Va ninge consistent și se va depune strat de zăpadă de 15...20 de cm și izolat de peste 25 cm (echivalent în apă de 20...35 l/mp). Temporar vântul se va intensifica cu rafale de 45...50 km/h, va viscoli ninsoarea și vizibilitatea va scădea sub 100 m.
warnings.description: Heavy snowfall is expected, with snow accumulations of 15 to 20 cm, and isolated amounts exceeding 25 cm (water equivalent of 20 to 35 l/sqm). The wind will temporarily pick up with gusts of 45 to 50 km/h, causing blowing snow and reducing visibility to less than 100 m.

warnings.headline: Vântul se va intensifica, cu rafale în general de 55-60 km/h, va viscoli ninsoarea și vizibilitatea va scădea sub 100 m.
warnings.description: Wind gusts will reach 55...60 km/h, will be blizzard and visibility will decrease below 100 m.

warnings.headline: Vântul va continua să aibă intensificări cu viteze la rafală de 50-70 km/h, viscolind zăpada deja depusă și determinând scăderea vizibilității.
